title: picris hieracioides subsp. longifolia
intro: Picris hieracioides subsp. longifolia, commonly known as Long-leaved Hawksbeard, is a plant species in the dandelion family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, digestive problems, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Picris hieracioides subsp. longifolia include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial effects, making it a potential remedy for wound healing, infections, and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant are believed to include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
